The account executive should correct the claim: NovaLearn does **not** delete all customer data immediately on request under standard policy.

**Correct timeline (standard policy):**
- Upon contract termination, the tenant is suspended for 30 days during which the customer can request data extraction [NL-007#NL-007-S06].
- Active databases, vector indexes, and file stores are permanently deleted within 60 days of suspension — i.e., 90 days total from contract termination [NL-007#NL-007-S06].
- Cold storage backups are deleted per the 30-day backup rotation cycle, with full cryptographic erasure (via KMS key deletion) completed within 120 days of contract termination [NL-007#NL-007-S06].
- Immediate revocation of access: data is immediately removed from active user access and TutorChat queries, but physical deletion from primary storage and backups takes up to 90 days [NL-019#NL-019-S05].

**Qualification (custom enterprise terms):**
- Enterprise customers can negotiate custom deletion timelines (e.g., immediate 7-day deletion, custom backup retention), but these must be explicitly documented in the signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and configured by the engineering operations team [NL-007#NL-007-S06].
- Per NL-032, sales reps must not overpromise immediate deletion; always cite the official 90-day policy to avoid legal risk and customer success friction [NL-032#NL-032-S06].
